title: Activity
description: Represents a full activity object used for adding, editing and viewing a single item.

id.description:
Gets or sets the activity id.
This field is ready-only.  Any data modified in this field will not be saved.

activityTypeId.description: Gets or sets the activity type id.

timeSpent.description: Gets or sets the time spent completing the activity.  Time is represented in minutes.

dueDate.description: Gets or sets the due date of the activity.

isOpen.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether this activity is open or closed.

subject.description: Gets or sets the activity subject.

notes.description:
Gets or sets the saved activity notes.
This field is ready-only.  Any data modified in this field will not be saved.

first25Notes.description:
Gets or sets the first 25 characters of the activity notes.
This field is ready-only.  Any data modified in this field will not be saved.

createdById.description:
Gets or sets the id of the user who created the activity.
This field is ready-only.  Any data modified in this field will not be saved.

createDate.description:
Gets or sets the create date.
This field is ready-only.  Any data modified in this field will not be saved.

createdByType.description: Gets or sets the type of the created by.

lastUpdatedById.description:
Gets or sets the id of the user who last updated information on the activity.
This field is ready-only.  Any data modified in this field will not be saved.

lastUpdateDate.description:
Gets or sets the last update date.
This field is ready-only.  Any data modified in this field will not be saved.

lastUpdatedByType.description: Gets or sets the last type of the updated by.

closedDate.description:
Gets or sets the date the activity was closed.
This field is ready-only.  Any data modified in this field will not be saved.

assignedUsers.description: Gets or sets the list of users who are assigned to the activity.   List contains brokercontact ids.

notifiedUsers.description: Gets or sets the list of users who get notified on activity updates.   List contains brokercontact ids.

accountId.description: Gets or sets the account id.

businessEntityId.description: Gets or sets the related business entity id.

planId.description: Gets or sets the related plan id.

opportunityId.description: Gets or sets the related opportunity id.

accountContactId.description: Gets or sets the id of the related account contact.

censusId.description: Gets or sets the related census id. This can also be refered to as the EmployeeId.

employeeName.description: Gets or sets the name of the related employee.

accountLocationId.description: Gets or sets the related account location id.

rfpId.description: Gets or sets the related RFP id.

proposalId.description: Gets or sets the related proposal id.

recurrenceId.description: Gets or sets the recurrence id.

recurrenceType.description: Gets or sets the text describing the recurrence.

massAddId.description: Gets or sets the id indicating which mass add process created the activity.

brokerCarrierLinkId.description: Gets or sets the broker carrier link id.

activityBaseType.description: Gets or sets the base type.

hasWorkflowItems.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance has workflow items.

customFields.description: Gets or sets the custom fields.

recreate.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether this Activity should be recreated when it is closed. 
This field is used only by mass activities created by plantypes.

ActivityUsers.description: Users class for Notified and Assigned users

brokerContactId.description: Gets or sets the broker contact id.

activityId.description: Gets or sets the activity id.

BaseType.description: Indicates the base type of an activity
